# MemProtect

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_docs.py in kagantmr/zuzu. Do not edit. -->

Changes the protection of a range of the caller's mapped memory.

| Number | Selector | Blocking | Since |
|---|---|---|---|
| `0x0B` SVC_MANAGEMEMORY | `MNGMEM_PROTECT (2)` | no | 2.0 |

```c
Err MemProtect(VirtAddr va, size_t size, MemProt new_prot);
```

**Registers:** `(va, size, prot) -> r0 status`

## Parameters

| Name | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `va` | in | Start of the range, page-aligned. |
| `size` | in | Length in bytes. |
| `new_prot` | in | PROT_READ / PROT_WRITE / PROT_EXEC, but never writable and executable. |

## Returns

ZUZU_OK, or an error code.

## Errors

| Error | Condition |
|---|---|
| [`ERR_NOPERM`](../errors.md#err_noperm) | `new_prot` is beyond what the mapping was allowed when it was made: the PERM_WRITE / PERM_EXEC of the handle it came from, or what the injector chose. |
| [`ERR_BADARG`](../errors.md#err_badarg) | The range is not mapped, not aligned, or the protection is not allowed. |
